exercise_notes: First priority: four full-range assisted pull-up sets of 4-8 controlled reps, leaving 1-2 clean reps in reserve. Use an assisted pull-up machine or secure foot support until a band is available; select Pull Up (Band) when logging band assistance. Record assistance and keep grip, range and setup consistent between A and C. After all four sets reach 8 clean reps, reduce assistance slightly. Rest 2-3 minutes. Before working sets, do 1-2 easy scapular pull-up preparation sets; these are additional warm-up work, not part of the four working sets.
